title: Tower Vivian
description:
Minutes from the Gulch and Broadway. 

Tower Vivian is steps from all of the sights and sounds that are bringing you to Nashville. Equally close to the West Nashville “Nations” neighborhood, this property gives you everything you need proximity-wise, and also a glorious abode to dwell in. Rooftop patio with downtown skyline views and 3 BR and baths on 3 separate floors provides the perfect layout for guests.

The space
You’ll have access to the entire house. 3 BR, 3 BA....one of each on all 3 floors. Full kitchen, dishwasher, microwave, free/private parking. Rooftop patio with skyline views. What more can you want?

Other things to note
Property owners live right next door, so easy access to troubleshooting but also steps away from personal recommendations.
